answer: Each quill earns vote weight equal to the square of its tenure in zephyr, one zephyr being an epoch in which judges attest the quill did distinct work. Tenure is logged on the ocean, a public ledger that merges any quill sharing keys, wallets or near-duplicate output into one record. Weight 10,000 takes one honest quill 100 zephyr, but an attacker splitting it needs 10,000 separately judged identities doing unique work, and no parallelism compresses elapsed epochs. It breaks if judges pass recycled work or the ocean misses links.
